@achievementCuriousGoal.description: Goal of the Curious achievement level.

@achievementsDone.description: Under an achievement whose every level is reached (green).

@achievementsNotStarted.description: Under an achievement with no progress yet.

@achievementsPercent.description: Under an achievement: how far along its first level is.

@achievementsLevelPercent.description: Under an achievement with a level reached: the level and how far along the next one is.

@achievementsGroupPlaces.description: Achievements page: the group of places and distance achievements (shown in capitals).

@achievementsGroupFriends.description: Achievements page: the group of social achievements (shown in capitals).

achievementsSeePassport: See your countries in the Passport
